content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV announced a slew of news, including the premiere date for Silo season 4.

Silo season 4 will premiere in the summer of 2027 and will be the show's final season.

Silo season 3 is currently airing (you can watch here), with new episodes dropping weekly until September 4.

But last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, alongside news for some of its other sci-fi shows, Apple had a surprise for Silo fans.

Silo season 4 will arrive next summer and will bring the series to a close.

Here's the announcement post from Apple TV on X:

In the streaming era, it can take years for shows to release new seasons, especially big-budget sci-fi series like Silo.

However, Apple has been proactive about speeding up the return of some of its shows by renewing them early. With Silo, for instance, seasons 3 and 4 were prepped at the same time and filmed back-to-back.

We've got six more weeks of new Silo episodes to savour. But fans won't have to wait long after this season wraps for season 4.

What are your thoughts on Silo season 3 so far? Let us know in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, but you can get a discount by bundling it with Apple One.
